name: automated bead-based extraction method
description: Uses magnetic beads to bind DNA, with automated systems handling washing and elution steps.

name: manual bead-based extraction method
description: Uses magnetic beads manually to bind DNA, followed by washing and elution steps performed manually.

name: organic extraction
description: Uses phenol-chloroform to separate DNA from proteins and other cellular debris.

name: chelex
description: Uses Chelex resin to chelate metal ions and protect DNA during boiling, releasing DNA from cells.

name: ethanol precipitation
description: Uses ethanol to precipitate DNA out of solution, allowing for its collection by centrifugation.

name: none (direct PCR)
description: Amplifies DNA directly from biological samples without prior extraction or purification.

name: manual silica-column-based extraction method
description: Uses silica columns to bind DNA, with manual washing and elution steps.

name: automated silica-column-based extraction method
description: Uses silica columns in an automated system to bind DNA, with automated washing and elution steps.

name: rapid procession solution
description: Uses specialized buffers to quickly lyse cells and release DNA for rapid analysis.
